localBiteReport: Reports from Choctawhatchee Bay in early-to-mid October 2026 (most recent available: approximately one week old) show inshore fishing picking up as the Destin Fishing Rodeo gets underway. Redfish and speckled trout are the main story in the bay and bayou system, with slot-size reds being found around docks and channel drop-offs and trout still in the mix. A guide out of Santa Rosa Beach noted that sheepshead action is expected to improve in the coming weeks in the Choctawhatchee. Water temperature at this location is 79°F. Note: Half Hitch's most recent Destin report is dated September 28, 2026 (roughly three weeks old), but its body content was not retrievable; the previous readable report from September 7 confirmed redfish as the dominant bay species with flounder gigging starting to pick up.
